result.title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://windowso.github.io/MMTA/
result.summary: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MMTA——涵盖时间序列、文本与视觉三种模态的跨模态互补基准（九大领域、3,524 条测试样本，含分类与预测），评测八个 MLLM 后指出把时间序列写成文本会带来超长 token 序列并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，并提出带时间序列编码器与模态感知 token 布局的 TimeOmni-v。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对长视频下「视觉证据是否真正进入内部状态并细粒度对齐」的失败诊断与 LVR 的证据保留、LOOK 收益问题相关，时间位置对齐与模态感知布局设计可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 状态表示。
